aide.description: Answers to the most frequent questions about your space.

deposer.question: How do I submit a request?
deposer.reponse: Choose “New request” at the top of the menu, then the document you need. Fill in the form and attach the requested documents: your entry is saved as a draft and you can come back to it later. You submit the request after accepting the sworn statement.

payer.question: How do I pay the fees and duties?
payer.reponse: After submitting, pay the filing fee from the request page, through TrésorPay or by bank transfer. If the request is granted, the duties are paid the same way. Each confirmed payment gives a receipt to download.

suivre.question: How do I know where my request stands?
suivre.reponse: The request page shows each step completed and what is expected from you. You are informed by notification, e-mail and SMS at each step; the bell at the top of the screen shows the latest notifications.

document.question: Where do I find my signed document?
document.reponse: Once issued, the signed document can be downloaded from the request page. Its QR code lets anyone check online that it is genuine and still valid.

traiter.question: What do I have to handle?
traiter.reponse: The “To do” section gathers the files awaiting an action from you, with their number next to the section. Open a group to handle the files one after another; every action is recorded.

signer.question: How do I decide and sign?
signer.reponse: Documents for which you are the signatory in the catalogue arrive in “To do”. Give the decision (approval or reasoned rejection), then sign and issue the document: it is sent to the applicant at once.

catalogue.question: How do I change the catalogue and fees?
catalogue.reponse: The administrator proposes a new version of a document sheet (documents required, time limits, fees, signatory); it only applies once approved by the Minister. Requests already submitted keep the conditions in force when they were submitted.

rechercher.question: How do I quickly find a file or a page?
rechercher.reponse: Use the search at the top of the screen, or the Ctrl+K shortcut: type part of the number, the name of the document or of a page. Accents and capitals do not matter.

compte.question: How do I change my language or password?
compte.reponse: Open the menu under your name, top right: “My profile” lets you choose the language (French or English) and change your password. Your name, e-mail and profile are managed by the administrator.
